svg.text: Figure A: Avalanche Validator Lifecycle Model v0.8.0 — Daily State Transition Overview
Macro Execution Architecture: Two cadCAD PSUBs, Complete State Feedback X_(t+1) → X_t, Separated Input Categories, and Invariant Verification
Pre-accepted queue due on day t
Drawn once per Monte Carlo run
Common random numbers tied to keys
PSUB 1: Main Daily Lifecycle Transition Block
cadCAD block returning p_lifecycle policy and 24 parallel state-update functions
Calls run_stages(stages, state=X_t, day) executing the 6 internal stages sequentially:
Note: Duration selection and stake selection execute inside Stage 4 (_stake_continuation).
Exogenous Q_t enters at Stage 6 (Assembly). Stages 1-6 are NOT independent PSUBs.
COMMON POLICY SIGNAL (stakes, days, out_stakes, issued_navax...)
Evaluated in parallel on pre-PSUB state snapshot X_t and common policy signal:
Keys: stakes, days_left, done, after_return, days, handed_on, returns, node_key
Logic: Copies active commitment array slices for C_(t+1)
Keys: out_stakes, out_days, out_done, out_last_days, out_returns, out_node_key
Logic: Copies eligible out-of-set array slices for O_(t+1)
4. State Readout Metrics (s_count, s_stake, s_out, s_nakamoto)
Logic: Aggregates: len(stakes), sum(stakes), len(out_stakes), Nakamoto key ratio
Keys: issued_navax, yield_gap_pp, started_stake_navax, started_stake_days_navax, offered_rate_30d
Logic: Copies daily fluxes and diagnostic signals into state record for metric readout
Total active stake on Primary Network
Potential rewards from new endogenous starts
Renewal yield gap in percentage points
Annualized rate offered for baseline stake
COMPLETE STATE FEEDBACK: Validated X_(t+1) = (C_(t+1), O_(t+1), Z_(t+1)) becomes Input X_t for Day t+1
Cylinder (Blue-Grey): Persistent Endogenous State Store (C_t, O_t, Z_t)
Inverted Triangle (Cream): Exogenous Input / Scenario Parameter (Q_t, D, ψ_prot)
Diamond (Muted Pink): Stochastic Behavioural Policy / Decision Stage
Pentagon (Sage Green): Mechanism / State Update Function *
Double-Border Box (Red): Formal Invariant Assertion (PSUB 2; raises InvariantError on failure)
Rectangle (Grey): Recorded Output Metric / Observable Vector Y_t
Dashed Blue Line: Inter-Timestep Feedback Loop (X_(t+1) → X_t)

* Adapted Visual Convention: In complex systems engineering (e.g. BlockScience / Polkadot specifications), pentagons denote control functions. Here, pentagons denote deterministic protocol mechanisms and state-update operations.
Model Boundaries: S_min = 2,000 AVAX constant (no duration-dependent admission frontier enforced in v0.8.0); no uptime/liveness/slashing; concentration over simulated node keys.
